slot.shape: 4 x 2 regions of 1123.2 x 1101.6 um + 187.92 um x-plane band between the rows (r and r + 4 stacked)

geometry.note: it2 relay objects (qfd_rly* / qkd_rly*) are regenerated with their chains, as in the Codex plans; they are counted, not checked.

root_rule: <= 15000 sinks per root: every leaf is its own root; no group-level tree

sizing.delay_tiles: closed-kit outlines (physical/ref_tile/qfd_tree_delay{1,2}_t), views under closure as qfd_tree_delay{N}_t-u52-baaa52fff
sizing.xplane: 3 x 1024 flops (pin, rot1, rot2) + 2 x 1024 mux8: ~2.9k um2 cells in 5,599 um2 (util 0.52)
sizing.xrelay: 512 enabled flops + 16 me replicas in 1,120 um2 (delay2 outline; mux + DFF per bit ~0.55 um2 -> util ~0.27)
